process.expected_observation: HTTP response shows a provider's unclaimed-resource error page

process.action: Register/claim the resource on the third-party service using the dangling name
process.technique: resource claiming (in an authorized test only)
process.expected_observation: Service now resolves and is served from attacker-controlled content

process.action: Confirm content is served under the victim's domain and assess trust implications (cookies, CSP, SSO trust)

Periodically audit DNS zones for dangling CNAMEs pointing to unclaimed services
